patch.value: Consolidate history commands: history-redact/history-repair/history-compact/activity/restore under pm history subcommands

pm history <id> stays the default view; history-redact -> pm history redact, history-repair -> pm history repair, history-compact -> pm history compact, activity -> pm history activity, restore -> pm history restore (old spellings aliased).
